# Vendored front-end assets

These files are served locally so the public menu does not depend on a third-party
CDN at runtime (important for availability and privacy in Iran).

| Package | Version | License | File |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bootstrap (RTL build) | 5.3.3 | MIT | `bootstrap/bootstrap.rtl.min.css` |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.11.3 | MIT | `bootstrap-icons/bootstrap-icons.min.css` + `fonts/` |
| Alpine.js | 3.14.9 | MIT | `alpine/alpine.min.js` |

Please update this table whenever a vendored file is upgraded.
